 Advertisement Bernalillo County to mail 2026 property tax bills by Nov. 2
 Property owners will have until Dec. 10 to pay their first-half or full 2026 tax bill, as the county prepares to collect approximately $1.02 billion for local public services
 Advertisement Updated: 6:57 AM MDT Oct 27, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Micheal Bolger Bernalillo County to mail 2026 property tax bills by Nov. 2
 Property owners will have until Dec. 10 to pay their first-half or full 2026 tax bill, as the county prepares to collect approximately $1.02 billion for local public services
 Updated: 6:57 AM MDT Oct 27, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Micheal Bolger BERNALILLO COUNTY, N.M. — Property owners should watch their mail for annual tax statements as the Bernalillo County Treasurer's Office prepares to send out 2026 property tax bills on Monday, Nov. 2.
 The mailing deadline falls on the next business day because Nov. 1 is a Sunday.
 Advertisement Owners who are not enrolled in the county's 10-month payment agreement can pay their taxes in full or divide the amount into two installments.
 The first half- and full-payment deadline is Nov. 10. However, taxpayers have until Dec. 10 to pay before their accounts become delinquent.
 The second installment is due April 10, 2027, with a May 10 delinquency deadline. Payments received after the dates may incur penalties and interest. 
 This year's property tax bills total roughly $1.02 billion. Once collected, the money will be distributed to taxing authorities, supporting schools, conservation programs, flood control, municipalities, and county and state services.
 Payments can be made online, by mail or in person. Details on payment methods are available at: https://www.bernco.gov/treasurer/paying-your-property-taxes-overview/ .
 For assistance, taxpayers can call 505-468-7031.
